When you set up a domain with Multi-AZ with Standby, consider the following limitations:
• The total number of shards on a node can't exceed 1000, the total number of shards on a cluster
can't exceed 75000, and the size of a single shard can't exceed 65 GB.
• Multi-AZ with Standby only works with the m5, c5, r5, r6g, r7g, c6g, m6g, r6gd and i3 instance
types. For more information on supported instances, see Supported instance types.
• You can only use Provisioned IOPs SSD, General Purpose SSD (GP3), or instance-backed storage
with standby.
• If you enable UltraWarm on a Multi-AZ with Standby domain, the number of warm nodes must
be a multiple of the number of Availability Zones being used.
